summary: gh plate bootstrap syncs the full template labels.yml registry (rename GitHub default case collisions instead of skipping Bug/Documentation/Question), applies Epic and Question labels when seeding starter issues, and uses a generic .plate init commit message without PLATE-repo issue numbers (#1255, #1256, #1266).
migration_impact: Re-run `gh plate bootstrap --apply` on repos that still have lowercase default labels or unlabeled bootstrap Epics/Questions; no config change required.
agent_notes: Label sync mirrors scripts/bootstrap_github.sh rename behavior; never deletes non-PLATE labels.
